newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP QUARTER-FINAL RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP QUARTER-FINAL RESULTS.

text.p: Quarter-final results in the Benson and Hedges Cup on Tuesday:
At Chelmsford: Surrey beat Essex by 6 wickets. Essex 214 all out in 45.5 overs (N.Hussain 52). Surrey 215-4 in 42.3 overs (G.Thorpe 73, A.Brown 71).
At Canterbury: Kent beat Warwickshire by 4 wickets. Warwickshire 304-8 in 50 overs (N.Smith 125; M.Fleming 4-58). Kent 306-6 in 49.3 overs (M.Walker 117).
At Leicester: Leicestershire beat Somerset by 20 runs. Leicestershire 197 all out in 46.2 overs (B.Smith 61, J.Whitaker 51; H.Trump 4-51). Somerset 177 all out in 47.5 overs.

At Headingley: Northamptonshire beat Yorkshire by 7 wickets. Yorkshire 253-9 in 50 overs (M.Vaughan 85, B.Parker 58; D.Capel 5-51). Northamptonshire 254-3 in 46 overs (R.Bailey 70 not out, D.Capel 67).
